tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shrī sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i yi ge/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams na 'khod pa'i skye 'gro spyi dang / khyad par mnga' ris dbus gtsang mdo khams bod 'brog rang khral na gnas pa mtha' la springs pa/ chos grwa chen po thub bstan rnam rgyal 'di nyid sngon dus su rgyal ba kun gyis mkhyen rab kyi ngo bo rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba yongs rdzogs gnas lnga mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po kun mkhyen chos kyi rje bsod nams seng ge phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'i zhal snga nas kyi/ spyir mdo sngags kyi bshad sgrub rnam dag gi rgyun dang / khyad par du rje btsun sa skya pa'i bshad srol dri ma med pa dar rgyas yun du gnas nas skye dgu thams cad rnam grol thar pa'i bde ba la 'god pa'i nyer 'tshor bskrun par mdzad pa nas bzung mkhan rab rim can 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang zhal mi gnyis pa sha stag gis bshad sgrub kyi dga' ston rgya cher spel ba'i phyag rjes bzang po la brten/ dge 'dun rnams kyang mthun zhing khrims gtsang ba mdo sngags bka' bcu rab 'byams pa grags pa don ldan du ma mchis shing / sku gsung thugs rten bla ma gong ma'i phyag rgyun spyan ltos bzang po'i chos thob so so'i 'chad nyan dang / dus chen gyi rgyun sogs rnam dkar legs mdzad bzang po'i rgyun rnams kyang rang gzhan dad pa 'phel ba'i rang bzhin du mchis pas/ des na chos grwa chen po 'di nyid mi nub dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas nas ris med 'gro la phan bde'i gru char stsol phyir bsod nams bsags pa'i yul mchog dam pa 'dir rang rang gi 'byor pa dang bstun 'bul ba'i dngos po rgya cher 'bul sdud pa so so'i lag tu stobs pa gal che zhing / de dag gi dge 'bras chud mi za ba'i phyir/ nged rang dang chos grwa chen po 'di nyid du bzhugs pa'i mkhan slob dge 'dun tshang mas dpal sa skya'i bla ma gong ma ye shes spyan ldan rnams dang /

khyad par kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po la gsol 'debs rtse gcig ngos/ dngos po thams cad thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi dge rgyun ma shin tu smin pa'i do dam gang che dang 'khor gsum yongs dag gis bsngo smon gyi rtsis zin pa cis kyang bgyid pas/ khyed sbyin bdag dad can tshang ma gong 'khod kyi 'bru don la dang 'dod lhur blangs bgyid pa shin tu gal che zhes dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog pho brang nas bris// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ shrī sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros dpal bzang po'i yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
